killers.title: OCPP 2.0.1 marks every event that happened while the station was offline, so a gap is visible.

mutants.title: A meter reading is written in the shape of the wrong version

killers.name: test_a_good_card_starts_the_session
killers.title: A card the back office accepts starts the session and the car begins to charge.

killers.name: test_the_station_asks_the_back_office_before_it_lets_anyone_charge
killers.title: Before a session starts the station asks the back office about the card and sends the card number.

killers.name: test_the_same_card_stops_the_session_it_started
killers.title: Holding the same card to the reader again ends the session the driver started.

killers.name: test_another_card_cannot_stop_somebody_else_s_session
killers.title: A different card does not end a session it did not start: a stranger cannot stop your charge.

killers.name: test_a_refused_card_can_be_followed_by_a_good_one
killers.title: After a refused card the reader still works: the next good card starts the session.

killers.name: test_the_answer_about_a_card_uses_the_words_of_its_version
killers.title: The back office answers about a card in the shape its version defines, down to the field names.

killers.name: test_a_card_on_one_connector_does_not_touch_the_other
killers.title: A card presented at one connector starts a session there and leaves the other connector free.

killers.name: test_the_pilot_states_walk_through_a_session_in_order
killers.title: Over one session the pilot goes A, B, C, B, A, and the reported status follows each step.

killers.name: test_the_station_says_who_is_holding_back
killers.title: When nothing is flowing the station says whether the car or the station itself is the reason.

killers.name: test_a_fault_on_the_pilot_is_reported_at_once
killers.title: A fault on the pilot wire is reported as a fault, and no power flows.

killers.name: test_every_change_of_status_is_reported_once
killers.title: The station reports a change of status when it happens, and does not repeat itself in between.

killers.name: test_the_two_connectors_report_their_own_status
killers.title: Each connector reports its own status, and the number it reports is its own.
